instruction: Configure Chrome to automatically skip all advertisements on streaming platforms.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide built-in functionality to skip advertisements on streaming platforms. Ad-blocking requires extensions or external tools, and even those cannot universally skip ads embedded in video streams.
